'''Clue scroll (elite)''' is a [[cryptic clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (elite)|elite]] [[Treasure Trails]]. 

The clue alludes to the fact that all players start the game at [[combat level]] 3, and that [[Vannaka]] is the sixth NPC spoken to when going through [[Tutorial Island]].

==Clue info==
{{Clue info
|id = 686
|tier = elite
|text = The cryptic reveals who to speak to:<br><br>You were 3 and I was the 6th. Come speak to me.
|notes = Speak to [[Vannaka]] in [[Edgeville Dungeon]].
